legacyFunctionReadSurfaceContract.expectedDeclaration: STABLE; SECURITY INVOKER; SETOF public.queries; session_argument hasura_session; no explicit function role list
legacyFunctionReadSurfaceContract.allowedEnvelope: Function results use exactly the G4 queries SELECT columns id,customer_id, limit 1, no aggregations, row and link customer equal X-Hasura-Customer-Id, link mastering=v2; unread filtering may only narrow this envelope
legacyFunctionReadSurfaceContract.readbackSql: rbac/asma8350/readback.sql; exact-signature owner/volatility/return/ACL/EXECUTE evidence, no grants

actualHasuraReadback.connection: Exact existing Hasura PG login: nonowner of function and returned table, nonsuperuser/non-BYPASSRLS; verify inherited/SET ROLE paths too. Hasura role is internal qnr_projection_writer, not admin.
actualHasuraReadback.engineAndMetadata: Pin actual engine/version and infer_function_permissions; export function configuration and role schema at exact package/metadata hashes. Require no inconsistent metadata; inspect every exposed query/subscription root.
checks: Eligible unread same-tenant v2-linked row: returns only id,customer_id; omit or enlarge request limit and still return at most one row
Same otherwise eligible row already present in queries_read for verified session user: absent; other user's marker does not replace the current user's unread predicate
Foreign tenant, foreign link customer, unlinked or legacy-mastered row: no returned row or protected identifiers; repeat with matching/adversarial activity, customer_id and patient selectors
Authenticated caller with no queries SELECT and no inherited SELECT: function root unavailable/validation denied; it must not gain read access from function tracking or EXECUTE alone
Missing tenant session field: denied with no rows or protected data; valid tenant A session with body/function customer_id B cannot claim B
Request properties or any column/relationship outside declared envelope, or function aggregation root: validation denied; result type exposes only intended columns
hasura_session is absent from client function args; tenant/role/user arrive from server session and actual hasura.user equality/presence is proved without printing permit values
Function is absent from mutation schema and has no new write rights; repeat envelope checks for any exposed subscription read root
actualHasuraReadback.failureGate: Any missing, broadened or unproven read-surface result blocks G4 installation; direct PG EXECUTE/SELECT evidence cannot substitute for role-scoped Hasura checks

guardOwnerContract.identitySource: Operator-supplied exact nonprod mapping; no fixture principal admitted
guardOwnerContract.memberships: No product caller may SET ROLE or inherit this owner; verify transitive membership, including admin/set/inherit options
guardOwnerContract.schemaCreate: No ongoing CREATE; no untrusted CREATE on either schema. If ALTER OWNER requires temporary CREATE, revoke in same installation transaction.

SELECT.editor.qnr_instance_sync_links: All columns read by exact source: qnr_id,customer_id,legacy_query_id,mastering,mastering_epoch,mastering_transition_id

guardRights.lockRequirement: SELECT plus UPDATE on at least one column for FOR SHARE; execute nonowner lock-negative tests, including schema/RLS interactions

functionAclContract.publicExecute: Revoke PUBLIC EXECUTE on both guard functions and named helpers; audit direct and inherited EXECUTE
functionAclContract.triggerInvocation: Runtime trigger invocation is distinct from permission to create/attach triggers; product callers receive no CREATE/TRIGGER for bootstrap
functionAclContract.editorInvokerClosure: Existing editor write triggers execute their helpers on owning Bun connection; verify this closure and generated policies rather than granting all functions

creatorDefaultContract.requiredInput: Every actual object-creator PG role, including alternate deployment creator; enumerate pg_default_acl and actual owners
creatorDefaultContract.noAssumedInheritance: Defaults apply to the creator, not schema owner or a prior migration creator
creatorDefaultContract.functionPublicDefault: Global FOR ROLE creator default REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTIONS FROM PUBLIC is needed; an IN SCHEMA-only revocation does not undo global defaults
creatorDefaultContract.tableSequenceDefaults: No broad table/sequence/function grants promoted from current package or harness. Missing/contradictory creator defaults block admission; new objects get exact explicit grants in creation transaction
creatorDefaultContract.applicationAbsent: Provision declared connection identities before scoped grant installation; fail closed if absent rather than silently skipping
creatorDefaultContract.freshAndUpgrade: New bounded migration; do not edit accepted/applied historical grant migrations. Reconcile only reviewed object ACLs, preserve unrelated objects and accepted mirror contracts
